svg.title: Manhattan's street grid
svg.desc: A cartoon map of midtown Manhattan from above, not to scale. Between the Hudson River on the left and the East River on the right, long avenues run north and south (9th Ave, 8th Ave, 7th Ave, 6th Ave, 5th Ave, Madison) and shorter cross streets run east and west (53rd to 58th Street), with Central Park along the top. Every block between them is filled with buildings. A yellow taxi waits at A, the corner of 8th Avenue and 54th Street. A red dashed straight line from A to B, at 6th Avenue and 57th Street, is crossed out: no cutting through buildings. The taxi route in blue goes 2 blocks east along 54th Street, then 3 blocks north up 6th Avenue, numbered 1 to 5: 2 across plus 3 up is 5 blocks.
svg.text: Avenues run north and south; streets run east and west. The taxi counts blocks: 2 across + 3 up = 5.
